No visible tracking or additional lesions are present in this image.

description.short_caption: Ulcerated lesion with violaceous borders on the dorsum of the left hand.
description.detailed_description: The image shows the dorsum of a left hand with a central ulcerated lesion surrounded by violaceous, raised borders. The lesion appears erythematous and inflamed, with two central areas of tissue breakdown. The surrounding skin shows mild erythema but no overt signs of additional lesions or tracking. The setting suggests a clinical evaluation for a localized infectious or inflammatory process.

description.short_caption: Subcutaneous nodules and swelling tracking proximally on the left arm.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the medial aspect of the left arm. A gloved hand is palpating an area of subcutaneous swelling.
